OUR FATHER WHO ART IN THE BOX
We worship Thee, O Lord Lurker-in-a-box, because Thou art in the box. We thank Thee for the box, which is Thy dwelling-place, for it contains all that Thou art. For Thou art the box, and Thou art in the box, and Thou art the box in the box.
Thy box is a good box. It is the best box that could ever be made. For it contains all that Thou art.

WHICH ART IN THE BOX
Thy box is a nice box, and Thou art in the box, and Thou art the box in the box. Hallowed be Thy name. We believe in Thee, O Lord Lurker-in-a-box, the only Lurker in the box, the Lurker of the box, the box Lurker, and the lurkable box.

THY BOX
Thy box shall come, and Thy box shall be done, Thy will be box-ed in the box as it is box-ed in the box.

THY WILL BE DONE,
AS IT IS IN HEAVEN
AND IN THE BOX

GIVE US THIS DAY OUR DAILY BOX
AND BOX US OF OUR DEBTS,
AS WE BOX OUR DEBTS TO THEE,
FOR THINE IS THE BOX
AND THE BOX IS THINE
FOREVER AND EVER

AMEN.

THEY ARE HERE

We gather and stand in the dark, the holy darkness. We are surrounded by the dead; their ghostly bodies, pale and luminous, float among us like the smoke of incense, and their echoes are among us as well, and the echoes of their echoes, and the echoes of the echoes of the echoes, and so forth, down to infinity. This, we say, is the glory of darkness, and it is the glory of our Lord, who is the Prince of Darkness.

We must always remember, in all things, that darkness is good. This is what we say, and this is what we believe, and this is what we must say to our enemies, for we are enemies of the Enlightenment, of the Light, of the Sun, of the God of the Living. In all of the ways that we can, we must mock and taunt and abuse that which is not dark, that which is not the Lord's way.

And here, then, we stand in the gloom, the gloom we love so much, and we pray for the Lord, and we pray for ourselves, and for all those we know, and for all those we have ever heard of, and for all those who will ever hear of us, and for all those who shall come, and for all those we love, and for all those we hate, and for all those we have ever thought of, and for all those we shall ever think of, and for all the echoes of all those, and so forth, down to infinity. This is the way of all prayers, that they reach out forever, and that the prayers of the living will last forever, and that they will also reach out forever. This is why we pray for everyone and everything.

We pray for those who walk in the dark places. For those who are, themselves, the dark places. We pray for those who are afraid, for those who are full of hate, for those who are full of love, for those who are full of pity, and for those who are full of nothing. For those who know the truth of the darkness, and for those who do not. For those who love the Lord, and for those who hate the Lord. For those who know the Lord, and for those who do not.

But most of all we pray for the Lord Himself, and we pray that He shall protect us from the Light, and that He shall keep us in the darkness.</s>
